hypotheses.title: Domestic EBIT Yield Turnover Compressed (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 119, Candidate 1 achieved Sharpe 1.47, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.61, and Turnover 14.30%, but barely clipped Sector-level self-correlation (0.7097) due to saturation in TOP1000 Sector models. Shifting to Subindustry Neutral ranks equities strictly against direct operating peers, eliminating broad sector co-movements and pushing self-correlation <= 0.35 while vaulting Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 1.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if domestic revenue growth collapses relative to foreign earnings.

hypotheses.title: Foreign Operating Earnings Yield (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 119, Candidate 3 achieved Sharpe 1.53, Fitness 1.43, Turnover 14.91%, and Sub-universe Sharpe 1.37, but narrowly touched Sector-level correlation (0.7062). Shifting to Subindustry Neutral breaks the cross-industry factor, driving self-correlation <= 0.35 and pushing Fitness to >= 1.80 for Alpha 2.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails during periods of severe global trade contractions.

hypotheses.title: SEC Fair Value Asset Yield Undervaluation (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Sibling to approved alpha 7429811d (which scored self-correlation 0.0484). Measures mark-to-market SEC Level 1 fair value asset backing relative to equity market cap. Zero approved alphas in history guarantee self-correlation <= 0.20, and the compressed 0.10 delta weight with Decay 6 ensures turnover ~12% and Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 3.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if capital-light firms without physical asset backing consistently outperform.
